_about: Recommended ranges, applied on top of the firmware-allowed min/max in param_tables/. Only bounds tighter than the firmware's own in at least one release are listed (null = the firmware's bound applies); the stricter of the two always wins. Checked against PX4 1.13-1.15 metadata on 2026-10-27, where every stock default passes; re-check after regenerating the tables.

MC_ROLLRATE_I.why: PX4 sets no maximum; this caps it at 2.5x the 0.2 default.

MC_PITCHRATE_I.why: PX4 sets no maximum; this caps it at 2.5x the 0.2 default.

MC_YAWRATE_I.why: PX4 sets no maximum; this caps it at 4x the 0.1 default.

MC_PITCHRATE_D.why: Same cap PX4 puts on MC_ROLLRATE_D; the pitch D is left open.

MC_YAWRATE_D.why: Same cap PX4 puts on MC_ROLLRATE_D; the yaw D is left open.

MC_YAWRATE_P.why: At 0 the yaw rate loop has no feedback at all.

MC_ROLL_P.why: Below this the attitude loop barely holds the vehicle level.

MC_PITCH_P.why: Below this the attitude loop barely holds the vehicle level.

MC_ROLLRATE_MAX.why: A near-zero rate limit stops the vehicle correcting its attitude.

MC_PITCHRATE_MAX.why: A near-zero rate limit stops the vehicle correcting its attitude.

MC_YAWRATE_MAX.why: A near-zero rate limit stops the vehicle correcting its heading.

MPC_XY_P.why: At 0 position hold doesn't correct position at all.

MPC_Z_P.why: At 0 altitude hold doesn't correct altitude at all.

MPC_XY_VEL_MAX.why: Below 0.5 m/s position modes can't make way against wind.

MPC_MAN_TILT_MAX.why: Under 5 degrees the pilot has almost no authority in manual modes.

MPC_THR_MIN.why: Above this the vehicle can't descend or recover from a climb quickly.

MPC_THR_MAX.why: Below this there's no thrust headroom to climb or stabilise.

COM_DISARM_LAND.why: -1 turns auto-disarm off; past 20 s the props stay armed on the ground.

RTL_RETURN_ALT.why: Lower than this, RTL flies home at obstacle height.

RTL_DESCEND_ALT.why: Lower than this, RTL descends almost onto the ground before landing.
